title: The parent goal's BINDING table stops at phase 014 while the packet ships a fifteenth phase
description: The BINDING table lists fourteen rows, 001-research through 014-fix-deep-review-findings (goal.md:70-83), and the section's own rule at goal.md:65-66 says each child goal is authoritative for its phase and binds as if written here. 015-fix-follow-up-review-findings/goal.md exists on disk and the same file's Progress table records it as Done at goal.md:131, so the packet both ships and credits a phase whose goal the directive never binds. Phase 015 carries the advisor id-noun change and the Aside installer pin, and its own decisions D1 to D3 therefore bind nothing.
scopeProof: Both files are inside the declared review target; the omission is visible by comparing the BINDING row count against ls -d 0* of the packet root, which returns fifteen phase folders.

title: The parent goal cites a review report path that no longer resolves
description: The Progress row reads Deep review 2026-11-24 | Done, FAIL | Four opus-medium lineages, 28 iterations: 0 P0, 2 distinct P1, 18 distinct P2. Report at review/review-report.md. The packet's review/ directory holds deep-review-config.json, five fan-out files, lineages/, observability-events.jsonl and orchestration-status.log, and no review-report.md. The report the row describes is review-archive/20261124T070727Z-restart/review-report.md, whose opening line matches the row exactly and whose counts match too. The numbers are right; only the path is stale, and it went stale when the run was archived on restart.
scopeProof: The citation and the archive are both inside the declared review target; find over the packet returns three review-report.md files, all under review-archive/, and none at the cited path.
